Coronal

f z=2,d
@(40)
{
f3 p = z * nor(2*C.rgb - R.xyy),t=p
d=2; @(6) d+=d,
p += sin(p.zxy*d+z-T) / d
z += abs(1-len(p.xy))/3;
O += f4(1.1-cos(p),)/z/z/abs(len(t.xy)-1)
}
O = tanh(O / 30) https://t.co/1VgdVWe5rh
